titleEn: Minimized Maximum of Products Distributed to Any Store
title: 分配给商店的最多商品的最小值
summary: 把每种商品分给若干商店，每店只能一种商品，求所有商店商品数最大值的最小可能值。
insight: 若限制每店最多 limit，一种数量 q 需要 ceil(q/limit) 家商店。所需商店总数随 limit 单调下降，二分最小可行 limit。
pitfalls: 同一种商品可拆给多店

solutions.title: 二分单店容量
solutions.idea: 以所需商店数是否不超过 n 判断容量可行性。
steps: required<=n 时 right=middle，否则 left=middle+1，返回 left

code.java: class Solution { public int minimizedMaximum(int n,int[] quantities){int left=1,right=Arrays.stream(quantities).max().getAsInt();while(left<right){int middle=(left+right)/2;long required=0;for(int quantity:quantities)required+=(quantity+middle-1)/middle;if(required<=n)right=middle;else left=middle+1;}return left;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimizedMaximum(n:Int,quantities:IntArray):Int{var left=1;var right=quantities.maxOrNull()!!;while(left<right){val middle=(left+right)/2;var required=0L;for(quantity in quantities)required+=(quantity+middle-1)/middle;if(required<=n)right=middle else left=middle+1};return left} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minimizedMaximum(int n,vector<int>& quantities){int left=1,right=*max_element(quantities.begin(),quantities.end());while(left<right){int middle=(left+right)/2;long long required=0;for(int quantity:quantities)required+=(quantity+middle-1)/middle;if(required<=n)right=middle;else left=middle+1;}return left;} };
